sentences.text:
Suneel Kumar Saini vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 December,
2024

Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 2371 of 2024
 Suneel Kumar Saini ........Applicant
 Versus
 State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, A.G.A. for the State.

Applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.127 of 2024, under Section 323, 354C, 376(2)(n), 376(3)
Ipc, Section 3(a)/4(2), 5(l)/6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and
Section 67B of the Information Technology Act, 2000, Police Station- Kotwali Gangnahar, District-
Haridwar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has already been examined at the trial; the victim has not supported the prosecution case and has been declared hostile by the prosecution; there is no forensic or any other evidence against the applicant.
4. Learned State Counsel admits this fact, but he would submit that the victim had supported the prosecution case during investigation.
5. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
7. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
